integrity: Proof gives analytic global minimizer classification and Laplace asymptotics; checker provides independent finite consistency tests, not external certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed shear and reset intensity after nondimensionalization; fixed finite longitudinal diffusion; stationary positive transverse parabolic rare rays only. No critical-window or finite-sample theorem, and priority remains subject to external validation.
title: A universal two-age caustic in the far tails of shear-driven resetting diffusion
